contributions.detail: 2 typed ledger contribution lines sum to 500.00 + 50.00 = 550.00 exactly = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell = summary line 4. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 550.00 and is NOT summed as an increment (first report of the cycle, so period and YTD coincide). THE HANDWRITTEN $3,000.00 'Personal loan / Doug Witney' ENTRY ON THE SAME LEDGER IS DELIBERATELY NOT AN ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION ROW, and this is traced, not assumed: the filer's own cover assigns exactly 3,000.00 to line 3, 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period', and NOT to line 1 or line 4, and the whole ladder closes on that assignment — line 3 3,000.00 + line 4 550.00 = line 5 subtotal 3,550.00; 3,550.00 - line 6 2,703.70 = line 7 close 846.30. Adding the loan to the contribution rows would produce 3,550.00 against a stated 550.00 and would silently re-classify the filer's own accounting, which this transcription does not do. The loan is recorded in full in `notes` (date 5-11-2010, 'Personal loan', Doug Witney of Springville, UT, $3,000.00 with raised cents) so nothing about it is lost.

3.measure_note: THIS PAGE IS NOT A COUNTY SCHEDULE FORM: it is the candidate's own TYPED landscape ledger with TWO side-by-side tables (Contributions left, Expenditures right) and NO printed rules at all — rowbands.py returns 0 h_rules, so there is no underline grid to walk and the 'text sits above its rule' convention does not apply here. Bands were measured instead with `rowbands.py --text-lines --col 84,92`, i.e. a dark-run projection restricted to the EXPENDITURE amount column: 22 text bands, of which band 1 (12.42) is the printed 'Amount' header and band 22 (56.87) is the printed column total $2,703.70; the 20 in between are the data rows, at a regular pitch of 2.03, and are stored above padded by 0.30 on each side. The `rows` list and `cell` therefore describe the EXPENDITURE table only. The page carries a +1.0 deg skew on a landscape sheet (skew drift 2.26% of page height), so a band measured in one column does NOT transfer across the sheet — the two CONTRIBUTION rows are consequently carried as explicit per-row `geometry` strings measured in their own column (x 44-54) and those win over this frame. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi: the FIRST expenditure band pct:84,14.01,8,1.89@p3 rendered '$519.48' (recorded 519.48, the filing fee) and the LAST expenditure band pct:84,52.57,8,1.89@p3 rendered '$500.00' (recorded 500.00, the 5/1/2010 design/advice line) — no neighbour bleed, so the 20 bands are correctly indexed. The two contribution boxes were proved the same way: pct:44,16.08,10,1.95@p3 rendered '$500.00' and pct:44,18.17,10,1.94@p3 rendered '$50.00'.

notes: legacy_colAB COVER + SUMMARY, but NO COUNTY SCHEDULE A OR SCHEDULE B EXISTS IN THIS FILING — a document property, verified with pdfinfo (3 pages total): p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election', signed 'May 9 2010', amendment box marked No, stamped received MAY 11), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (header box left blank by the filer), p3 the candidate's OWN typed LANDSCAPE ledger headed 'Douglas Witney / Campaign Contributions/Expenditures', carrying both sides side by side with their own column headers. Both sides are `transcribed` (the lines were read) — the absence is of the county's schedule FORMS, not of the entries. Because both sides live on one sheet, itemized_pages_A and itemized_pages_B are both '3'. THE FILER'S CENTS NOTATION: the cover writes cents as a raised/superscript pair ('550' with a raised '00'); the ledger prints ordinary decimals. A HANDWRITTEN ADDITION on the ledger's contribution side, dated 5-11-2010 (the day the clerk stamped the filing received, two days after the signature), reads 'Personal loan / Doug Witney / [street] Springville, UT / $3000.00' with raised cents. It is NOT carried as a contribution row: the cover assigns exactly 3,000.00 to line 3, Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period, and the entire ladder closes on that assignment (3,000.00 + 550.00 = 3,550.00; less 2,703.70 = 846.30). Recorded here in full so the disclosure is preserved; not re-classified, per the standing rule against adjudicating a filer's own accounting. PAGE-FACE candidate name is 'Douglas Witney' (Republican, residence city Springville) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row; page-face Office Seeking reads 'Utah County Commission Seat B', agreeing with index.csv. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — published in the clear, so donor street lines were visible and were reduced to city at READ TIME.
